title: Cuppini 2011 · Superior colliculus integration
citation: Cuppini, C., Magosso, E., & Ursino, M. (2011). Organization, maturation, and plasticity of multisensory integration: Insights from computational modeling studies. Frontiers in Psychology, 2, 77.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.simulation: Five main unisensory and multisensory populations with four interneuron populations.
published_method.readout: Steady-state normalized responses and enhancement relative to the stronger unisensory response.

stimulus_type.value: Spatial visual and auditory network inputs
stimulus_type.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 3–5, SC Model Description, Multisensory integration and Figs. 1–4

value.spatial_representation: One-dimensional topological chains with overlapping receptive fields
value.unit: Sigmoid with threshold and saturation plus low-pass response
value.lateral_connections: Mexican-hat excitation nearby and inhibition at larger distances
value.input_competition: Interneurons suppress ascending inputs under AES influence and mediate competition among ascending modalities
